trap.label: zero conditional
trap.wrong: If you will heat ice, it melts.
trap.right: If you heat ice, it melts.
trap.why: Em português 'se você aquecer' usa subjuntivo/futuro; em inglês o presente simples nos dois lados, sem will.

mcq.q: If you mix red and blue, you ___ purple.
If it ___ , the ground gets wet.

opts: If I was tired, I sleep.
If I will be tired, I sleep.

fix.wrong: If it will rain, the street gets wet.
fix.right: If it rains, the street gets wet.

fix.wrong: If you heat ice, it melted.
fix.right: If you heat ice, it melts.

fix.wrong: If he don't sleep, he gets tired.
fix.right: If he doesn't sleep, he gets tired.

rewrite.prompt: Una com if: “It rains. The grass grows.”
rewrite.answer: If it rains, the grass grows.

rewrite.prompt: Una com if: “You heat ice. It melts.”
rewrite.answer: If you heat ice, it melts.

rewrite.prompt: Negativa: “If I sleep, I'm tired.” (não durmo)
rewrite.answer: If I don't sleep, I'm tired.
